ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones occupying the lateral distal lobes, flanking a central low-intensity black region. Fine-scale high-intensity mottling is distributed within the central dark zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees, with the vertex oriented toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; right lobe exhibits a series of three distinct jagged peaks (5-8 pixel amplitude) near the medial notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep of the leading edges terminating in sharp distal tips, with a convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of 6 distinct circular white ring-like pixel groups (3-5 pixels in diameter) located in the lower-central black region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three dark, parallel linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity white region of the distal right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of high-contrast, high-texture barnacle colonies attached to the far distal tips of both lobes and along the lower leading edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, 'torn' appearance of the trailing edge on the left lobe, indicating previous tissue loss or significant jagged wear.
